W2ReviewC1Mismatch.item: Re-run the frozen C1 calibration counter at d9c496b and final rev. Check the exact mismatch count 1 to 0 and attempt to find a second unsuperseded r36 control-input discrepancy.

W2ReviewC1Correction.item: Read the appended r36 control-input erratum and compare every clause with committed manifest, adapter, and receipts. Report any remaining assertion that treats 91373d55557fe26c431e9e3dd9e8fa4a00d7b57f as a lane object.

W2CriticC1Vacuity.item: Try to make C1_R37_PASS true with the committed manifest absent, malformed, or detached from the old scorecard claim. Determine whether the counter is fail-closed for each case.

W2MutateSourceTree.item: Change only the manifest source_panel_tree value in a disposable copy. Run the replay adapter and verify it refuses before scoring with source_tree_mismatch.

W2MutateSpecimenList.item: Remove or rename one source specimen from the manifest list in a disposable copy. Confirm the adapter detects the mismatch against the pinned Git tree before invoking either counter.

W2MutateEmptyPanel.item: Add a specimen JSON to the committed empty-panel tree in a disposable copy. Confirm the adapter refuses the tree instead of scoring a non-empty panel as the empty control.

W2MutateMissingManifest.item: Remove the empty-panel manifest from a disposable tree and run the adapter. Confirm a declared SETUP failure occurs before scoring and no v1/v2 receipt is emitted as valid.

W2ReviewReplayRevision.item: Verify each replay receipt identifies a resolvable counter revision and a resolvable panel revision, with the panel revision an ancestor of the final revision. Flag any scratch-only hash.

W2CriticCounterSeam.item: Inspect the replay adapter's monkeypatch boundary. Try to show it changes anything besides the public-panel source path; sealed set, tool source, runner source, scoring predicate, and counter bytes must remain frozen.

W2ReviewV1Expected.item: Re-derive why the r35 v1 counter should PASS the zero-slot public panel and verify the committed control output has tool_sha_ok=1 and pub_kill=0/0, pub_accept=0/0.

W2ReviewV2Expected.item: Re-derive why frozen v2 rejects the same zero-slot panel because cardinality targets are 6/3/9. Confirm the only failed conditions are those expected from the empty panel, not a bad tool pin.

W2CriticC2Target.item: Try to make the two-case C2_R37 predicate pass when the escaped-quote trailing comment leaks or when the literal-hash content is blanked. Report exact counterexample output.

W2MutateRemoveAnsiState.item: Remove only the `ansi-c` quote-state branch in a scratch copy and run code-view/measure.py against it. Confirm the trailing-comment fixture flips red while the literal-hash fixture remains accepted.

W2MutateCloseQuote.item: Mutate the ANSI-C branch so backslash no longer skips the next character. Use the frozen `$'it\'s'` fixture and report whether the escaped quote is misread and the comment leaks.

W2MutateLiteralHash.item: Mutate the branch to treat `#` inside ANSI-C quote as a comment. Confirm the literal-hash fixture catches overblanking and preserves equal-length output semantics.

W2MutateNewlineCount.item: Mutate the code-view scanner to blank the newline along with the comment. Confirm the fixture detects changed length or newline count and returns non-clean.

W2ReviewSelftestCount.item: Re-run the tool selftest at its pinned revision and verify the two ANSI-C cases are included in the reported denominator, not merely printed outside the tally.

W2CriticPinMatch.item: Compare counter-pin.json to the actual committed tool and frozen r36 counter blobs. Attempt one-byte mutations of each expected hash and verify the repin wrapper refuses before execution.

W2MutateToolPin.item: On a disposable counter-pin copy, change one hex digit of tool_sha256 and execute c2-repin.py. It must exit SETUP rather than report a passing re-attestation.

W2ReviewFullPanel.item: Re-derive all full-panel v2 counts at the frozen r37 revision: 6/6 kill, 3/3 accept, 9 slots, 9 distinct, sealed 4/4 kill and 3/3 accept, zero invalid.

W2CriticScopeBounds.item: Compare r35 AttackQuotedHash findings to the new docstring and report. Ensure nested `$(...)` quoting, unquoted backslash-newline, and parameter-branch claims remain explicit holds, not silently promoted.

W2ReviewS104Quote.item: Open the pinned Bash source and re-count the S104 quote (<=25 words). Verify exact §ANSI-C Quoting location and that the row teaches only source-backed behavior.

W2CriticQuality73.item: Test the new committed-input QUALITY criterion against a one-byte source tree mutation and a missing manifest. It must have a concrete failure path and a resolvable red-before pointer.

W2ReviewLessonGate.item: Check every S104 Gate field (URL, access date, <=25-word quote, exact anchor) and each Mistakes tuple (class, evidence, captured-by, fix) against committed bytes.

W2CriticSCORECARDDepth.item: Re-run command D at the final lane revision. Confirm the numeric depth score remains 9 under its recorded-ledger rubric and the new parser support is recorded as a capability, not a fabricated tenth case.

W2ReviewTrendExpansion.item: Check whether the S104 source row alone creates an admitted knowledge entry on uncovered ground. Challenge any `expansion: improved` claim unsupported by the corpus coverage map.

W2ReviewTrendQuality.item: Compare the pre-fix red-before and post-fix code-view results, plus the r37 QUALITY criterion. Decide whether quality improved or whether an open defect remains.

W2ReviewTrendDiscernment.item: Check the non-author r36 closure disagreement and r37 Mistakes/QUALITY learning. Identify whether the round has enough outside admit/reject evidence for improved discernment or must say unchanged/unprovable.

W2MutateOutputPredicate.item: Change the expected output label in the code-view measurement script. Confirm a stale or forged label cannot make C2_R37_PASS true when either fixture fails.

W2ScoutWavePolicy.item: Inspect the committed round-37 w1/w2 specs and their validator outputs. Re-derive counts, v1 band, role mix, reportDir, no model pins, and the w2 dispatch dependency.

W2ScoutMisrootSweep.item: Re-run the fleet-root porcelain sweep and content search for tameshi round-37 seat outputs. Do not copy or delete peer-owned files; report only attributable candidates.

W2ReviewShonenRestraint.item: Verify all four SHONEN boxes remain `[~]` and their evidence pointers resolve. Flag any `[x]` without a named non-author verifier or any statement that operator-owned promotion has completed.

W2CriticReportMarker.item: Falsify the final round report against the required section order, claim naming, receipts, census before/after, trend verdicts, SHONEN lines, Stale-lane line, tool installs, and landed hash pointers.
